observations.p10_board_1024: Final6 default and sidebar variants show the fourth lane clipped at the right edge; Final7 source fix is pending real verification.
observations.strict_N01: 62 typed changes over 91.5459 seconds; cadence 1.4994–1.5033 seconds; save/window-close/reopen visible in same app process, not a cold process restart.
observations.N06: Snapshot content and binding were physically verified; immediate first click while autosave pending remains unverified.
observations.O05: Empty/invalid names blocked and cancel returned; physical Undo/Redo/Undo retained bytes/checksum and canonical path consistency; legacy storage path/title normalize to UUID-prefixed path/title.
